name: No Time for Mercy
source:
Fifteen year old Victoria Huang should have been over the moon when her best friend Naomi Liu reappeared back in her life, after she and her mother vanished without a trace half a year ago. 

But something is horribly, terribly wrong. 

No Time For Mercy is a character-driven horror visual novel about bloodthirsty shapeshifters, and time eroding childhood friendships.

[From [url=https://awesometrinket.itch.io/no-time-for-mercy]itch.io[/url]]
